page_title: TextSniper - Capture and extract any text from your Mac's screen | images

sources.entry: TextSniper - Simple yet powerful OCR app in your Menu Bar. Instantly copy and paste text from anywhere. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1528890965?platform=mac)

summary.name: TextSniper
summary.one_liner: TextSniper is a macOS menu bar OCR app that captures text from any selected area of the screen and copies it to the clipboard.
use_cases: Copying text from images, screenshots or PDFs that cannot be selected
Grabbing text from YouTube videos, online courses or presentations
Reading text aloud with text to speech for dyslexia or reading difficulty
Capturing QR codes or barcodes from the screen
Translating or learning foreign language text shown on screen
summary.what_it_does: TextSniper lets you start a capture with a customizable shortcut (default CMD+Shift+2) or from the menu bar, then select a screen area. The text in that selection is recognized with OCR and copied to the clipboard for pasting elsewhere. It works on text from YouTube videos, PDFs, images, webpages, screencasts and presentations. It can also capture and convert QR codes and barcodes, and includes a text to speech feature. The app lives in the menu bar and does not appear in the Dock.
notable: Select any screen area and the recognized text is copied straight to the clipboard
Customizable keyboard shortcut and menu bar access, no Dock icon
Text to speech and QR/barcode capture included
Offered as a one-time purchase with a 7-day money-back guarantee
caveats: Requires macOS Catalina or newer; language support depends on macOS version (English only on Catalina)
Each license is limited to one Mac; major upgrades cost extra
Can misread text heavy with code symbols
